changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Add strict revisioned implementation inputs without changing the legacy claim API.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE modeling_model_implementation SET implementation_revision = COALESCE(implementation_revision, 1), current_implementation_checksum = CASE WHEN model_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN model_checksum ELSE lpad(md5(id::text || ':implementation-revision:1'), 64, '0') END, input_mode = 'GENERATED', inputs_json = jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object('generatorType', 'LEGACY_CLAIM', 'config', jsonb_build_object()) ), field_mappings_json = jsonb_build_array(), settings_json = jsonb_build_object(), materialization = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(materialization), ''), 'table');
UPDATE modeling_dbt_artifact a SET implementation_revision = COALESCE(i.implementation_revision, 1), node_kind = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(a.artifact_type), ''), 'DBT_NODE'), materialization = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(s.materialization), ''), 'table') FROM modeling_model_spec s LEFT JOIN modeling_model_implementation i ON i.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND i.model_spec_id = s.id WHERE s.id = a.model_spec_id;

INSERT INTO modeling_model_implementation_revision ( id, tenant_id, implementation_id, revision, content_checksum, input_mode, inputs_json, field_mappings_json, settings_json, ownership, materialization, created_by, created_date ) SELECT ( substr(md5(i.id::text || ':implementation-revision:1'), 1, 8) || '-' || substr(md5(i.id::text || ':implementation-revision:1'), 9, 4) || '-' || substr(md5(i.id::text || ':implementation-revision:1'), 13, 4) || '-' || substr(md5(i.id::text || ':implementation-revision:1'), 17, 4) || '-' || substr(md5(i.id::text || ':implementation-revision:1'), 21, 12) )::uuid, i.tenant_id, i.id, i.implementation_revision, i.current_implementation_checksum, i.input_mode, i.inputs_json, i.field_mappings_json, i.settings_json, i.ownership, i.materialization, i.created_by, i.created_date FROM modeling_model_implementation i ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, implementation_id, revision) DO NOTHING;
